name: MongoDB Source Connector
description: MongoDB collection discovery, finite snapshots/backfills, and durable change-stream CDC.
use_cases: Ingest MongoDB collections via change streams and bounded backfills.

entity.name: MongoDB Source
entity.description: MongoDB source connector with change-stream CDC.

connection_string.help: Required mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// URI. Credentials are redacted from logs.

database.help: Database name (required if not present in the URI path).

serverSelectionTimeoutMS.help: Driver server selection timeout in ms.

tls.help: JSON: tls, tlsCAFile, tlsCertificateKeyFile, tlsAllowInvalidCertificates, ca (PEM).

collections.help: JSON string array allow-list of collection names.

exclude_collections.help: JSON string array deny-list of collection names.

backfill.help: JSON: enabled, start_date (ISO), cursor_field, cursor_strategy (objectid_timestamp|date_field|explicit), tie_breaker_field.

max_records.help: Optional bound on records per sync invocation.

max_duration_ms.help: Optional wall-clock budget per sync invocation.

idle_timeout_ms.help: End CDC run after this many ms with no events (default 15000).

connection_config_spec.help: Use a mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// connection_string plus database name.

sync_mode.description: cdc (live change stream), backfill (ISO-date bounded), or snapshot

schedule.description: Polling interval for bounded sync runs

connector_package.description: Native MongoDB inbound connector using official change streams.
follow_up_notes: Runtime: mongodb-source native engine (change streams). Variants with the same platform_native_provider can be template-only via NativeRecipeConnector.
custom_settings_schema mirrors MongoDBSourceConfig for UX/docs; zod/runtime validation in platform TypeScript.
